title: Show CSV rerun queue on Home
summary: Home now keeps the active CSV rerun queue visible in the Tauri shell while live progress refreshes continue.
reason: Fast live-run refreshes were re-rendering the Home queue panel without the /api/queue payload, replacing valid CSV rerun queue rows with a misleading No runnable message.
behavior_before: The Tauri Home panel could show active CSV rerun progress but then overwrite Next 5 Videos with No runnable, even while /api/queue returned rerun queue rows.
behavior_after: The Home panel recognizes CSV rerun queue rows, caches the last successful queue payload across fast progress refreshes, and shows the next rerun videos on the Tauri shell.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_web_static.py Home queue assertions for CSV rerun rows and cached fast-path queue rendering
tests/webview/test_webview_frontend_mutation_boundary.py guard for read-only CSV rerun Home progress and queue surfaces
manual_validation: Fresh Tauri shell served app.js with cached queue fast-path and /api/queue returned 99 rows, runnable=99.
Tauri screenshot proof captured in local temp workspace; path redacted for release package policy.
rollback_plan: Revert the Home/app.js/index cache-bust changes and the queue facade fallback/test additions; restart the Tauri shell to reload previous assets.
